title: Auth — Passkey Enroll (finish)
description: Submit the WebAuthn attestation that completes a passkey-enrollment ceremony. On success the auth service binds the credential to the subject's VID.

enrollmentId.description: The enrollmentId issued by the matching `auth/passkey/enroll/start` response. Echoed verbatim.

credential.description: AuthenticatorAttestationResponse as returned by `navigator.credentials.create`. Binary fields base64url-encoded.

deviceLabel.description: Final operator-facing label for the credential. Overrides any label passed at start.

Response.title: Auth Passkey Enroll Finish — response payload
Response.description: Acknowledgement of the registered credential. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/auth/passkey/enroll/finish/0.1#response.

credentialId.description: base64url-encoded WebAuthn credential id, durable identifier for later management.

subject.description: The VID the credential is now bound to. Echoed for symmetry with finish-time error responses.

deviceLabel.description: The label persisted with the credential.
